answer: Activity-recency weighting resists sybils: influence tracks sustained recent participation, decaying fast when an identity goes quiet, so dormant reserves confer nothing. A haven of pre-minted fakes held in reserve like pearls is worthless until each is continuously active, and the moment the attacker stops feeding one it fades. Keeping a grove of a thousand accounts all freshly active every epoch is a relentless cost, converting any stockpile into an ongoing operational burden.
